narrative_summary: The orderly told Hank about Walter's phone. Hank turns on his brother-in-law and the orderly is caught between them.

actions.reason: A patient hiding a phone from his own family is hiding more than a phone.

actions.description: Hank steps into the room and asks Walter whose phone is under the mattress.

actions.opening_line: You did the right thing telling me. Now tell me everything you saw.

actions.title: Choose what to tell Hank
actions.description: Hank wants the whole story. Decide how much of it he gets.

actions.reason: Walter's cover is blown; the hospital arc needs a new direction.
